title: An Act to Authorize the Secretary of State to Designate Law Enforcement Officers Employed by the Department of the Secretary of State to Investigate Alleged Violations of Election Laws

summary.text: This bill requires the Secretary of State to designate sworn law enforcement officers employed by the Department of the Secretary of State to investigate alleged violations of the election laws. It also changes the current law to require the Attorney General to designate a Deputy Attorney General or an Assistant Attorney General to assist in the investigation.
